<div class="card-body">
'''5D6-RA-7 (Fivedesix)''' is a [[Dark]] [[Character]] ([[Droid]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">5D6-RA-7（ファイブディーシックス）</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">同じ位置に「モッティ」か「ユレイレン」がいると、戦闘力＋１になる。同じロケーションに敵のドロイドか、自分のマウス・ドロイドを配備する場合、配備コスト＋１となる。「夜間状態」には、損耗の対象にならない。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-163o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">モッティ提督の補佐を務める。陰湿で執念深く、他のドロイドたちから恐れられている。ＩＳＢのスパイで、忠誠心に疑いのある帝国軍の将校を密かに監視している。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' 5D6-RA-7 (Fivedesix).

'''Card text:''' If Motti or Yularen is at the same site, power +1. Opponent's droids or your mouse droids deploy +1 at the same location. During nighttime conditions, this droid is not subject to attrition.

'''Lore:''' Aide to Admiral Motti. Foul-tempered and vindictive, and feared by other droids. An ISB spy who secretly watches Imperial officers whose loyalty is in doubt.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[5D6-RA-7 (Fivedesix)]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 98. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
